title: Garry Nolan debunking Atacama mummy

tellings.quote: Nolan where he got into becoming the UFO

plain: The Stanford biologist Garry Nolan is said to have entered the UFO field by way of the Atacama mummy, a tiny mummified body found in the Atacama desert that some took for an alien, which Nolan's work went on to debunk. Michels brings it up himself in passing as the start of Nolan's path into UFO research, without giving further detail.
